answer.text: Long press the Mode button on the right-hand switch cube to change the instrument cluster from analog to digital.
Alternatively, select the screen type option in the instrument cluster menu and centre press the joystick to change the screen type.
In that menu, the two options are Analog and digital screen, and you move between them by pressing the joystick up or down.

disclaimers.text: The manual describes these two methods differently, so confirm the steps with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.
